title: Ratio and proportion: practice set 2
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 10 questions, 20 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: ₹2,250 is shared between Farhan and Gauri in the ratio 4 : 5. How much does Farhan get?
A sum of money is divided among three friends in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4. The largest share is ₹840 more than the smallest. What is the total sum (in ₹)?
A hostel has enough rice to feed 120 students for 25 days. If 30 more students arrive, how many days will the rice last?
p : q = 3 : 4, q : r = 6 : 7 and r : s = 2 : 3. If p = 36, find s.
Five years ago the ages of Iqbal and Jatin were in the ratio 3 : 4. Five years from now they will be in the ratio 5 : 6. What is Iqbal's present age (in years)?

Leela starts a business with ₹60,000. Four months later Mohan joins with ₹90,000. Two months after Mohan joins, Leela takes out ₹20,000. The profit at the end of the year is ₹55,000, shared in proportion to investment × time. What is Mohan's share (in ₹)?
x : y = 3 : 5 and y : z = 4 : 7. What is (2x + y) : (y + z)?
A taxi fare is a fixed charge plus a charge per km. A 10 km ride costs ₹230 and a 16 km ride costs ₹338. What does a 25 km ride cost?
The monthly incomes of Anil and Bala are in the ratio 4 : 3. Anil spends 80% of his income and Bala spends 70% of his. Bala saves ₹600 more than Anil each month. What is Anil's monthly income?
A sum of money is divided among A, B and C. A gets half as much as B and C together, and B gets one-third as much as A and C together. C gets ₹600 more than A. What is the total sum (in ₹)?
